title: Committee of Supply debate on MDDI Head Q: AI adoption, online safety and cybersecurity
what_it_is: A Committee of Supply debate on the Ministry of Digital Development and Information's Head Q budget, opened by Mr Sharael Taha moving a $100 reduction and followed by ministerial responses.
why_it_matters: The debate covers measures intended to help more local enterprises adopt AI, with the National AI Impact Programme aiming to support 10,000 local enterprises over three years. It also covers online safety, scam and misinformation risks, and a planned AI translation tool to make public-facing materials more accessible to non-English speakers. The record does not quantify the effect on households or individual workers beyond these stated aims.

key_points.point: Mr Sharael Taha moved to reduce the Head Q allocation by $100.
key_points.speaker: Mr Sharael Taha
key_points.quote: That the total sum to be allocated for Head Q of the Estimates be reduced by $100

key_points.point: He said the MDDI Government Parliamentary Committee filed coordinated cuts across six themes.
key_points.speaker: Mr Sharael Taha
key_points.quote: The MDDI Government Parliamentary Committee (GPC) has consistently championed across six key themes.

key_points.point: He asked what the National AI Council's role will be and whether it will have execution authority.
key_points.speaker: Mr Sharael Taha
key_points.quote: What precisely is its role? Will it have execution authority, oversee cross-Ministry implementation, or remain advisory?

key_points.point: He proposed evolving CTO-as-a-Service into AI capabilities as a service for SME clusters.
key_points.speaker: Mr Sharael Taha
key_points.quote: First, evolve our CTO-as-a-Service into AI capabilities as a service, where pooled AI engineers deployed across SME clusters can deploy solutions for hands-on implementation.

key_points.point: He asked how the Government determined the four key sectors for the national AI Missions.
key_points.speaker: Mr Sharael Taha
key_points.quote: How did the Government determine the four key sectors for the national AI Missions?

key_points.point: Mr Gerald Giam called for international partners to communicate strategic red lines on prepositioned malicious code in critical infrastructure.
key_points.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
key_points.quote: The Government must work with international partners to communicate strategic red lines, explicitly stating that the prepositioning of malicious code in our critical infrastructure is an unacceptable provocation.

key_points.point: Mr Kenneth Tiong asked for a breakdown of the quantum safe budget between QKD and PQC and for a PQC migration deadline.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: Will the Minister disclose how the quantum safe budget breaks down between QKD and PQC, and when Singapore will set a PQC migration deadline?

key_points.point: Ms He Ting Ru asked whether the Ministry would consider a Select Committee on protecting children from social media harms.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
key_points.quote: would the Ministry consider my call last week to use a Select Committee to better examine global efforts to protect children from the harms of social media

key_points.point: Ms He Ting Ru noted IMDA's engagement with X over Grok's generation of non-consensual intimate images.
key_points.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
key_points.quote: The Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) has been engaging with X over Grok's generation of non consensual intimate images that were distributed en masse on the X platform.

key_points.point: Mr Fadli Fawzi asked why POFMA was not used against those behind AI-generated videos about Singapore politics.
key_points.speaker: Mr Fadli Fawzi
key_points.quote: why was the Protection from Online Falsehoods and Manipulation Act (POFMA) not used against those behind these videos?

key_points.point: Mr Fadli Fawzi proposed automatic declassification of Government records after 25 years, subject to national security concerns.
key_points.speaker: Mr Fadli Fawzi
key_points.quote: Any data or records held by the Government that could inform public debate should also be automatically declassified and made available to the public after 25 years, subject of course to legitimate national security concerns.

key_points.point: Mr Christopher de Souza said AI must remain a tool and not become the master.
key_points.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
key_points.quote: we must ensure that AI remains the tool, not the master.

key_points.point: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik proposed requiring companies to declare how AI transformation affects entry-level roles.
key_points.speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik
key_points.quote: companies should be required to submit a structured declaration detailing how their AI transformation efforts are expected to impact HR decisions, particularly for entry-level roles.

key_points.point: Mr Mark Lee asked the Government to consider upfront de-risking and performance-linked incentives up to 80% to 90% of qualifying transformation costs.
key_points.speaker: Mr Mark Lee
key_points.quote: Would the Government consider strengthening upfront support to meaningfully reduce early-stage exposure, and then introduce performance-linked incentives where firms that demonstrate sustained productivity gains receive enhanced support, potentially up to 80% to 90% of qualifying transformation costs?

key_points.point: Dr Choo Pei Ling noted Budget 2026 sets a National AI Council chaired by the Prime Minister and national AI Missions across advanced manufacturing, connectivity, finance and healthcare.
key_points.speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling
key_points.quote: a National AI Council chaired by the Prime Minister and national AI Missions to drive real outcomes across advanced manufacturing, connectivity, finance and healthcare.

key_points.point: Dr Choo Pei Ling said the future workforce must be fluent in both code and context.
key_points.speaker: Dr Choo Pei Ling
key_points.quote: The future workforce must be fluent in both code and context.

key_points.point: Ms Cassandra Lee asked how the Ministry will reduce uncertainty for SMEs adopting AI.
key_points.speaker: Ms Cassandra Lee
key_points.quote: how will the Ministry reduce uncertainty for SMEs adopting AI?

key_points.point: Mr Henry Kwek asked whether MDDI can work with top AI firms and hyperscalers to transfer know-how to local firms.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
key_points.quote: Can MDDI work with the top AI firms and hyperscalers already based here to transfer such know-hows to our local firms?

key_points.point: Mr Henry Kwek asked for MDDI's vision for keeping national media compelling, relevant and thriving.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
key_points.quote: Can MDDI outline its vision for keeping our national media compelling, relevant and thriving?

key_points.point: Ms Tin Pei Ling asked whether AI can be used to fight AI with safeguards against overreach, bias or erosion of privacy.
key_points.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling
key_points.quote: can we use AI to fight AI, with safeguards to avoid overreach, bias or erosion of privacy?

key_points.point: Ms Jessica Tan said Singapore should move toward targeted requirements for high-risk or high-impact AI systems rather than broad, one-size-fits-all rules.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo
key_points.quote: Singapore should move toward targeted requirements for high‑risk or high‑impact AI systems rather than broad, one‑size‑fits‑all.

key_points.point: Minister Josephine Teo said the National AI Impact Programme aims to support 10,000 local enterprises over the next three years to integrate AI into business processes.
key_points.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
key_points.quote: Over the next three years, the National AI Impact Programme aims to support 10,000 local enterprises to integrate AI into their business processes.

key_points.point: Minister Josephine Teo said 15% of SMEs and about seven in 10 workers use AI in some way.
key_points.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
key_points.quote: Today, 15% of SMEs and about seven in 10 workers use AI in some way.

key_points.point: Minister Josephine Teo said the National AI Council is not just an advisory role.
key_points.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
key_points.quote: So, the NAIC is not just an advisory role.

key_points.point: Minister Josephine Teo said a digital trust centre has been set up as Singapore's designated AI Safety Institute.
key_points.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
key_points.quote: we have set up a digital trust centre that is our designated AI Safety Institute.

key_points.point: Minister Josephine Teo said the approach is to use existing laws, sharpen them when necessary, and introduce new measures when needed.
key_points.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
key_points.quote: Use existing laws, sharpen the laws, if and when necessary, but also do not hesitate to introduce new measures when they are needed and when it is clear what can be done about them.

key_points.point: Senior Minister of State Tan Kiat How said an AI translation model is hoped to be usable by the later part of this year for non-English speakers.
key_points.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
key_points.quote: One of the objectives is to, hopefully, have a model which we can use by the later part of this year, to allow greater inclusivity and accessibility for those not speaking English to access our public-facing websites and other materials.

key_points.point: Minister Josephine Teo said there may be times when security is prioritised over convenience.
key_points.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
key_points.quote: there may be times that we need to prioritise the security more than the convenience.

key_points.point: Ms Jasmin Lau said systems must be fast but secure, efficient but resilient, ambitious but trusted.
key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: Our systems must be fast, but also secure. Efficient, but also resilient. Ambitious, but also trusted.

key_points.point: Mr Sharael Taha sought leave to withdraw his amendment.
key_points.speaker: Mr Sharael Taha
key_points.quote: I seek leave to withdraw my amendment.

what_happens_next: Mr Sharael Taha sought leave to withdraw his amendment. The National AI Impact Programme aims to support 10,000 local enterprises over the next three years. An AI translation model is hoped to be usable by the later part of this year.
